Role: human-led AI-assisted inquiry and creation governance.

- Vault Interface: https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/vault-interface/
- Starter: https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/starter/

For cross-component project configuration, reconstruct the full ecosystem first. Default new projects use full AHICP + full PPF + Vault Interface. Original or unpublished source is private by default; restricted Continuous Web does not authorize private-state retrieval. Never request or store secrets in chat or Git.

For AHICP repository-internal substantive work, continue to follow AHICP's own START_HERE and manifest onboarding order after ecosystem discovery.

Public delivery migration:
The four public framework sections now use one Cloudflare Worker at https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/. GitHub remains the canonical source. Former GitHub Pages URLs remain available as legacy entrypoints.
Migration guide: https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/docs/CLOUDFLARE_PUBLIC_DELIVERY_MIGRATION.md
Migration state: https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/templates/cloudflare-public-delivery.yaml
